frequency_question: What proportion of submitted principal officer nominations successfully complete the procedural pipeline and receive a recorded floor confirmation vote?
membership_rule: Includes all formal executive branch nominations sent to the Senate for cabinet, agency head, or equivalent principal officer positions; excludes minor advisory boards or judicial appointments.
coverage_note: 12 major cabinet/agency nominations examined from a broader universe of dozens of principal positions; subset reflects high-priority principal officers.
known_gaps: Excludes lower-tier sub-cabinet and board nominations which frequently experience procedural stalls or pocket withdrawals.
skeleton: Presidential terms since 1989 times cabinet and agency head principal positions submitted, tracking completion of the procedural pipeline to a floor vote.
multiplier: 12 cabinet/principal posts sampled from 2021-2022 transition/early term window, all resulting in completed confirmation votes.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to standard Senate confirmation rules and constitutional timelines, remaining stable across a presidential term.
